translation:
Head wind (頭風) for several years, arising from deficiency of the liver and kidney, and in addition the exterior yang is empty and open; with the slightest touch of external contraction, internal wind is stirred.

Zhi Mianqi (honey-fried Astragalus, 炙綿耆), Nüzhenzi, Guishen, Shijueming, Qingyan (salt, 青鹽) a little, Da Shudi, winter mulberry leaf, Fushen, Ganjü.

Qi deficiency and weak exterior, so that guest evil easily enters, stirring the liver wind, with headache and vomiting; treat by securing the exterior and nourishing the liver.

Zhi Mianqi, Bai Guishen, Baijili, Ganjü, Hei Shanzhi, Zhi Shouwu, Fa Banxia, Shijueming, Baishao, Sangye.

Distension of the diaphragm and headache — heat depression of the Shaoyang (少陽); guard against abdominal fullness.

Chaihu, Shijueming, Yujin, Xinhui pi, Niuxi, Hei Shanzhi, Gualoupi (Trichosanthes peel, 栝蔞皮), Baishao, Zexie, Foshou (Buddha's hand, 佛手).

Exterior deficiency with headache, and when severe there is abdominal diarrhea and vomiting. This is the liver wind insulting the earth (spleen); temporarily use the Wendan method (溫膽法).

Chuanlian, Fa Banxia, Fuling, Chiju, Hei Shanzhi, Jiao Zhu (stir-fried Atractylodes, 焦術), Shijueming, Guang Huo, Baishao.
translator_notes: 頭風 (tou feng) rendered as 'head wind', a classical term for chronic recurrent headache.

translation:
Cough and choking with spleen diarrhea, food and drink decreasing day by day, the six pulses soft and weak with little strength — this is evidence that earth does not generate metal; the condition is not light or trivial.

Zhi Yuzhu, Fushen, Chuan Beimu (Fritillaria, 川貝母), Guishen, Chuan Shihu, Bei Shashen (northern Glehnia, 北沙參), Shanyao (Dioscorea, 山藥), Xinhui pi, Xiangfu, Hongzao (red date, 紅棗).

Prolonged cough with diaphragm pain, the right pulse wiry and rapid — this is the incipient stage of lung flaccidity (肺痿); do not take it lightly.

Bei Shashen, Chuan Beimu, sheng Qi, Jubai, Dongguazi, Ziwan (Aster, 紫菀), sheng Hake, Miren, Yunling (Poria, 雲苓), Sangye.

Wheezing and cough with thick phlegm turning more severe, sore throat and weak pulse — this is not excess fire attacking metal, but deficiency of qi and depletion of liver fluid. If one again administers cooling agents, the spleen and stomach will be defeated and exhausted; one must use heavy doses of nourishing and supplementing, seeking to obtain effect.

Shudi, Chuanbei, Jubai, Tianzhuhuang (bamboo shavings, 天竺黃), Huai Shanyao, Yuzhu, Qizi, Fuling, Bei Maidong (roasted Ophiopogon, 焙麥冬), Jianlian rou (lotus seed flesh, 建蓮肉).

Cough and choking, foul phlegm, wheezing — the pulse is soft and the middle is deficient, the lung collaterals are injured; this is by no means a light illness.

Zhi Yuzhu, Chuan Baihe (lily, 川百合), Maidong, Fuling, Chuanbei, Maogen (imperata root, 茅根), Bei Shashen, sheng Hake, Jubai, Sangye, Zhimu.

Cold in the morning and heat in the evening, rapid pulse with vexation and thirst, choking cough not reduced — I suspect the exterior is deficient and the fire does not submerge to its root. Still use a method of engendering fluids and stopping thirst, with a little assistance of lowering qi (after taking cooling agents there was no effect; this is lower deficiency and upper excess).

Da Shudi, Juhong, Niuxi, Chuan Beimu, Miren, sheng Shigao (raw gypsum, 生石膏), Suzi, Zhimu, Bei Shashen, Lugen (reed root, 蘆根).

Pain in the throat, cough and choking with spitting of saliva, the six pulses not wiry and rapid — this is liver yin deficiency and the spleen not transporting fluids to spread downward. Therefore the stools are dry and bound; this is by no means a light illness.

Zhi Yuzhu, Chuanbei, Qizi, Jubai, Pipaye, Banxiaqu, Hake, Congrong, Xingren (apricot kernel, 杏仁), Renzhongbai.

The spleen and lung are both deficient, with aversion to wind and cough and wheezing; temporarily use the Yupingfeng method (玉屏風法), then supplement to obtain effect (a woman with body heat and dry retching for three months, little phlegm, abdominal pain, distension after eating, numbness of the four limbs, middle deficiency; fear of swelling).

Sheng Huangqi, Fangfeng, Suzi, Xuanfuhua (Inula flower, 旋覆花), Sangye, fresh Foshou, Zhi Yuzhu, Banxia, Fuling, Daizheshi, Juhong.

Warm evil lingering, cough and choking with foul phlegm; at this summer season, one should rescue the lung and eliminate fluid as the main treatment.

Sheng Qi pi (Astragalus bark, 生耆皮), Pipaye, Juhong, Zhimu, Huai Niuxi, Ejiao, sheng Miren, Sangye, Chuanbei, Maogen.

After the ear there was phlegm that ulcerated and discharged pus and has now healed; at present the interstices (腠理) are empty and open, with choking cough and spontaneous sweating; fortunately the Yangming (陽明) qi is vigorous, so it will not cause great harm. I propose a method of securing the exterior and moistening the intestines; otherwise guard against re-ulceration.

Sheng Qi, Zhimu, Maidong, Banxiaqu, Tian Xingren (sweet apricot kernel, 甜杏仁), Miren, Chuanbei, Hake, Juhong, Pipaye.

Pill formula: remove Hake; add Yangshen, Shijueming, Niuxi, and Panghaishen (sea cucumber, 胖海參); pound into pills.

Cough and choking with hoarse voice — middle deficiency with wood fire scorching metal.

Sheng Qi, Bei Shashen, Chuan Baihe, Ziwan, Juhong, Danpi, Maidong rou, Chuan Beimu, Niuxi, Sangye.

Cough with spitting of white froth, aversion to cold and soft pulse — this is metal cold and not binding the fluids; treat by harmonizing the spleen and protecting the lung, assisted by lowering qi.

Xi Dangshen, Bei Shashen, Qizi, Renzhongbai, sheng Hake, Zhi Yuzhu, Chuan Baihe, Jubai, Chuan Beimu, Chenxiang zhi (agarwood juice, 沉香汁).

Chills and fever with cough and choking, qi and yin both deficient — this is not a sudden illness, and a speedy recovery is not to be promised.

Zhen Sidang (genuine Codonopsis, 真四黨), Bei Shashen, Chuan Baihe, Qizi, Muli, Yuzhu, Da Maidong, Huai Shanyao, Jubai.

Prolonged cough with middle deficiency, aversion to cold and sore throat, the qi aspect insufficient — warming and supplementing is appropriate, but one cannot promise no danger.

Xi Dangshen, Shanyao, Da Maidong, Qizi, Jubai, stir-fried Shudi, Niuxi, Wuwei rou (Schisandra flesh, 五味肉), Yuzhu, Qingyan.

Prolonged choking with middle deficiency, wheezing with much phlegm, depletion of liver fluid, obstruction in the throat — the root of the illness is deep and firm, and a speedy recovery is hard to promise.

Zhen Xidang, Bei Wuwei, Chuan Baihe, Jubai, sheng Hake, Zhi Yuzhu, Da Maidong, Renzhongbai, Niuxi, Pipaye.

Cough and choking without stopping, the complexion and pulse lacking spirit — the qi aspect is deficient. Regulate from the spleen and lung.

Xi Dangshen, Bei Shashen, Zaoren, Chuanbei, Huai Shanyao, Zhi Yuzhu, Da Maidong, Fushen, Jubai.

Cough with froth and hoarse voice, middle deficiency, the lung qi not clear. One should use a light formula to soothe and regulate.

Xuanfuhua, Miren, Dongguazi, Pipaye, stir-fried Suzi, Ziwan rong (Aster, 紫菀茸), Juhong, Madouling, Zhimu, winter mulberry leaf.

Cough with qi rebelling and hoarse voice, seemingly belonging to yin deficiency with fire moving; yet the pulse does not show deficiency and rapidity — one can see that the latent evil has not been thoroughly cleared; one should use a light formula to harmonize and regulate.

Fresh Shihu, Xingren, Chuanbei, Madouling, Xinhui hong, Ziwan rong, Hake, Maidong, Pipaye, Chuan Yujin.

After an epidemic illness, with careless eating and drinking, abdominal distension and cough and choking — this is earth not generating metal; this is by no means a light illness.

Jiao Zhu 2 qian, stir-fried Suzi 3 qian, Chuan Shihu 3 qian, Fuling 2 qian, Juhong 1 qian, Dongguazi 3 qian, Faxia (processed Pinellia, 法夏) 1.5 qian, Baikou ke (cardamom shell, 白蔻殼) 4 fen, sheng Miren 3 qian, Zexie 1.5 qian, Guya (malt, 穀芽) 4 qian.

Cough with froth without stopping, wheezing and sore throat, and the six pulses are deficient and rapid without strength — one can see that the middle is deficient and the liver fluid is exhausted; this is by no means a light illness. Here I propose a method of filling and supplementing and protecting the liver, seeking to obtain effect.

Zhi Mianqi 2 qian, Maidong rou 2 qian, stir-fried Shudi 4 qian, Jubai 1 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Chuan Baihe 3 qian, Renzhongbai 1 qian, rinsed, Huai Shanyao 2 qian, Qizi 2 qian, Ejiao 2 qian, melted and taken with water.

Stomach pain with dry choking, the liver collaterals not harmonious — I fear there may be accumulated blood. Use a method of freeing the collaterals and moistening dryness, as a formula for temporary use.

Danggui xu (Angelica tail, 當歸鬚), Huai Niuxi, Taoren (peach kernel, 桃仁), Walengzi (Ark shell, 瓦楞子), Bai Fuling, roasted Muxiang, stir-fried Suzi, Loupi (Trichosanthes peel, 蔞皮), Chuan Yujin, Xinjiang xie.

The middle qi is not relaxed, and recently there is cough and choking, the six pulses wiry and tight — I only fear hemoptysis.

Stir-fried Suzi, Xuanfuhua, Juhong, Hake, winter mulberry leaf, Fa Banxia, Cao Yujin, Fuling, Guixu, Xinjiang xie.

The primordial qi is originally deficient; after malaria the interstices are open and the wheezing and cough turn more severe, the pulse rapid and without strength — this is the beginning of a consumptive (勞怯) condition; the time of recovery is not to be promised.

Zhi Qi, Bei Shashen, Maidong, Jubai, calcined Muli, Hongzao, Yuzhu (Polygonatum, 玉竹), Chuan Beimu, Shanyao, Fushen, winter mulberry leaf.

Follow-up formula:

Huangqi, Bei Shashen, Maidong, Jubai, calcined Muli, Qizi, Shudi, Chuan Beimu, Shanyao, Fushen, Kuandonghua (Tussilago, 款冬花), Jianlian.

Paste-nourishing formula (膏滋方):

Zhi Qi, Wuwei, Dan Congrong, Hutao rou, Shudi, Niuxi, calcined Muli.

Prolonged cough without stopping, middle deficiency with weak exterior, so that there is night sweating, distension of the diaphragm and wheezing, soft pulse — treat by strengthening the stomach and securing the exterior, and it may obtain effect.

Zhi Yuzhu, Shihu, Suzi, Hake, Chuanbei, Hongzao, Chuan Baihe, Jubai, Fuling, Miren, Sangye.

Follow-up formula:

Xi Dangshen, Bei Shashen, Shanyao, Tusizi (Cuscuta, 菟絲), Fuling, Hongzao, Zhi Yuzhu, Sha Miren (stir-fried Coix seed, 沙米仁), Jubai, Niuxi, Sangye.

Cough and wheezing with much phlegm, obstruction in the throat, the six pulses without strength. This belongs to middle deficiency with depletion of liver fluid; this is by no means a light illness.

Xi Dangshen 3 qian, Bei Shashen 2 qian, Hake 3 qian, Qizi 2 qian, Renzhongbai 1 qian, Da Shudi 4 qian, Chuan Baihe 3 qian, Xingren 2 qian, Jubai 1 qian, Pipaye 1.5 qian.

Internal heat with cough and choking, blood in the phlegm — this is heat depression in the middle burner, not arising from yin deficiency; one should not greatly supplement.

Bei Shashen 3 qian, Digupi 2 qian, Yuanshen (Scrophularia, 元參) 2 qian, Juhong 1 qian, Renzhongbai 1 qian, Maidong rou 2 qian, sheng Hake 3 qian, Zhimu 1.5 qian, Miren 4 qian, winter mulberry leaf 1 qian.

Water deficiency with fire moving, dry choking and hemoptysis, the six pulses without strength. One can see that the primordial qi is ever more deficient; I fear the illness will be severe at the turn of spring.

Yuan Shengdi 4 qian, Bei Shashen 2 qian, Maidong 2 qian, Shanyao 2 qian, Qiancao (Rubia, 茜草) 1 qian, Fen Danpi (moutan bark, 粉丹皮) 1.5 qian, Chuan Baihe 3 qian, Chuanbei 1.5 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Sangye 1.5 qian.

Cough and choking recurring — middle deficiency with weak exterior. One should regulate from the spleen and lung.

Zhi Yuzhu, Maidong rou, stir-fried Suzi, Jubai, Haifushi (pumice, 海浮石), Fa Banxia, Bei Shashen, Chuan Beimu, Fuling, old mulberry leaf.

Wheezing and cough injuring the middle, dry mouth and diaphragm pain — regulate by moistening the lung and strengthening the stomach.

Chuan Shihu, Fa Banxia, Xingren, Maidong, Juhong, Bei Shashen, stir-fried Suzi, Hake, Miren.

Previously there was loss of blood, caused by injury to the collaterals. Now there is cough and choking, spleen diarrhea with much phlegm, wasting of the flesh — evidence of insufficiency of the middle qi. The treatment should eliminate phlegm and strengthen the middle.

There is no other strategy than this.

Zhi Yuzhu, Huai Shanyao, Sangye, Bei Shashen, Jubai, Chuan Shihu, Fuling, Kuandong (Tussilago), Chuan Beimu, Zhi Cao (honey-fried licorice, 炙草).

Second consultation: the rushing choking has not stopped but is reduced compared to before, and the pulse is rapid but the force is moderated — this belongs to a favorable condition. But a speedy recovery is not possible.

Stir-fried Shengdi, Maidong, Chuanbei, Yuanwu ban, Danpi, Bei Shashen, Juhong, Xingren, winter mulberry leaf, Qingyan.

Prolonged choking with middle deficiency, weariness and heaviness of the limbs, the liver and gallbladder qi not relaxed, with frequent vomiting — the illness is in the liver and stomach, and rich supplementing is not appropriate.

Zhi Yuzhu, Xi Dang, Chuanbei, Shijueming, ginger-juice-roasted Zhuru, Banxiaqu, Fushen, Jubai, Maidong.
translator_notes: 肺痿 (fei wei) rendered as 'lung flaccidity', a classical consumptive lung condition, not equated to a modern diagnosis.
玉屏風 (Yupingfeng) is a formula name; kept as 'Yupingfeng method'.

translation:
Injury to the collaterals with the appearance of blood, fortunately without cough and choking — this is a disease of the qi aspect. Treat mainly by calming the liver and lowering qi.

Yuan Shengdi, Bei Shashen, Fushen, Huai Niuxi, Hu Ou (lake lotus root, 湖藕), Maidong rou, stir-fried Suzi, Zaoren, Chuan Yujin.

Warm evil injuring the lung, cough and choking with loss of blood, the six pulses wiry and rapid — I fear it will extend into the consumptive (怯) category.

Bei Shashen, Maidong rou, Yuanwu ban, winter mulberry leaf, Danpi, Chuan Beimu, Digupi, Huai Niuxi, sheng Miren, Juhong.

Internal injury with loss of blood, dry throat and diaphragm pain; although there is cough and choking, the six pulses are not wiry and rapid. Only the deficient yang does not submerge; one must conserve strength and regulate the treatment.

Di Shengdi (raw Rehmannia, 地生地), Chuanduan, Bei Shashen, Suzi, Di Wuban (tortoise plastron, 地武板), Danpi, Niuxi, Da Maidong, Juhong, old mulberry leaf.

In ordinary times there is phlegm and wheezing, and recently there is loss of blood, occurring frequently without stopping, the two-hand pulses deficient and soft — this is middle deficiency with injury to the qi aspect. One must cultivate yin and protect the lung, attending to both, and this is the best.

Huangqi, Chen Ejiao, Fuling, Gan Qizi, Zhi Xiangfu, Shudi, stir-fried Baishao, Zaoren, Niuxi tan (charred Achyranthes, 牛膝炭), Qingyan.

Internal heat with hemoptysis — the root origin is deficient. Treat by clearing yin and moistening the lung.

Digupi, Yuzhu, Zhimu, sheng Hake, Oujie (lotus node, 藕節), Bei Shashen, Maidong, Juhong, old mulberry leaf.

The yang collaterals are injured, with hemoptysis and diaphragm pain; the illness is prolonged and the pulse deficient, so the time of recovery is hard to decide.

Shudi, Maidong, Bei Shashen, Juhong, Huai Niuxi, Ejiao, Danpi, Shijueming, Qiancao, winter mulberry leaf.

Re-examining the pulse and symptoms, all show peace and safety, only that there is internal burning without stopping — the yin aspect is deficient.

Yuan Shengdi, Maidong, Bei Shashen, Guiban, Juhong, Danpi, Fushen, Nüzhenzi, Muli, Sangye.

In the morning there is cough with phlegm, the throat itches and blood appears — the fire of the lung and stomach; one should only treat by clearing and moistening.

Wu Xijiao (rhinoceros horn, 烏犀角), Tiantong, Zhimu, Pipaye, sheng Gancao, Xiao Yuandi (small raw Rehmannia, 小元地), Maidong, Juhong, winter mulberry leaf, Maogen.

After violent loss of blood the pulse is soft, the qi is timid and the stomach qi is weak — there is no strategy other than supplementing.

Zhi Huangqi, Maidong, Huai Niuxi, Muli, Guang Jubai (tangerine pith, 廣橘白), stir-fried Shudi, Wuwei, Gan Qizi, Fushen, Hutao rou.

Accumulated blood moving recklessly, without cough and choking, qi rebelling, the left pulse wiry and large — this is blood leaving and the collaterals not harmonious. Temporarily use a method of dispersing stagnation and freeing the collaterals, then take Hei Guipi (黑歸脾) to regulate.

Guixu, Danshen, Baizishuang, Chuan Yujin, Xinjiang xie, Taoren, Suzi, Niuxi tan, Shijueming.

The primordial qi is originally deficient, fire moving with hemoptysis, the diaphragm region not smooth — guard against violent vomiting.

Stir-fried Shengdi, Lianxu (lotus stamen, 蓮鬚), stir-fried Suzi, Fuling, Shijueming, winter mulberry leaf, Danpi, Guiban, Chuan Yujin, Huai Niuxi.

Take with lotus root juice (藕汁).

The primordial qi is originally deficient, fire moving with hemoptysis; although the blood has stopped, phlegm and saliva float upward — I fear the yin fluid is internally depleted. Here use a method of strengthening the middle and protecting the lung.

Zhi Yuzhu, Bei Shashen, Shanyao, Chuan Beimu, Jubai, Chen Ejiao, stir-fried Maidong, Fushen, Chuan Baihe, Qingyan.

After loss of blood there is cough with phlegm and foul qi — the liver and lung collaterals are injured. One cannot promise no danger.

Lingyangjiao, Maidong, Xingren, Qiancao, stir-fried Suzi, Maogen, sheng Miren, Zhimu, Juhong, Niuxi, winter mulberry leaf.

Wheezing and cough with hemoptysis and middle deficiency, the yang qi easily floats — secure the exterior and absorb the wheezing, treating both.

Zhi Mianqi, calcined Muli, Shanyao, Maidong, Bei Shashen, stir-fried Shudi, Huai Niuxi, Fuling, Jubai, Hutao rou.

The constitution is weak and fire flares, bone-steaming (骨蒸) not receding; although there are blood spots in the phlegm, fortunately without cough and choking. At this spring season, one must nourish the liver and kidney and regulate.

Yin Chaihu (starwort root, 銀柴胡), Shu Shouwu, Fuling, Qinjiao, Huai Shanyao, Bei Shashen, Chuan Bai (Phellodendron, 川柏), Zexie, Maidong.

The Yangming (陽明) collaterals are injured, with violent vomiting of blood from the nose, the vessels and collaterals empty and deficient, wheezing and palpitations.

Zhi Qi, Fushen, Baishao, Ruishi (amphibole, 蕊石), Oujie, Da Shudi, Zaoren, Qiancao, Niuxi.

Hemoptysis lingering for a long time, with much phlegm and sore throat.

Hafen stir-fried Ejiao, Zhi Yangshen, Jubai, sheng Miren, Dongguazi, Bei Shashen, Renzhongbai, Qiancao, winter mulberry leaf, Yanwo (bird's nest, 燕窩) 1.5 qian.

Sudden loss of half a dou (鬥) of blood, the spirit weary and the pulse faint — arising from excessive loss of blood, the yang qi has nothing to rely on, and there is a tendency to collapse. I tentatively propose a method of supplementing qi and nourishing the heart; this is the essential plan.

Zhi Mianqi, Maidong, Fushen, Hongzao, Muli, Xi Dangshen, Wuwei, Zaoren, Baishao, Zhi Cao.

Accumulated blood moving recklessly, the collaterals deficient with palpitations, fortunately without cough and choking — one should regulate with Hei Guipi (黑歸脾).

Zhen Xidang, Maidong, Fushen, Niuxi tan, Juhong, stir-fried Shudi, Yuanzhi, Zaoren, stir-fried Baishao, Sangye.

Hemoptysis recurring, the throat gate not smooth, the left pulse wiry and rapid — wood fire punishing metal.

Shudi, Bei Shashen, Pipaye, Qiancao, Niuxi tan, Ejiao, Chuan Baihe, Maidong rou, Juhong, Qingyan.

The constitution is originally insufficient, and previously there was loss of blood; now examining the pulse it is wiry and rapid and not still — this is water deficiency and fire not submerging to its root. In time guard against cough and choking.

Yuan Shengdi, Fushen, Maidong, Guiban xin (tortoise plastron core, 龜板心), Bei Shashen, Danpi, Zaoren, Danshen, Shijueming.

Hemoptysis with foul qi, the six pulses wiry and rapid and blurred — this is warm evil entering the collaterals, the lung and stomach injured; treat by clearing and rescuing the lung.

Lingyangjiao, Digupi, Xiangbei, Zhimu, Juhong, Oujie, Pipaye, Dongguazi, Qiancao, Miren, Maogen.

Excessive loss of blood, the wood evil insulting the earth (spleen), the pulse not soft — use the method of treating by promoting movement (以通為補).

Chuan Shihu 4 qian, Baishao 1.5 qian, Cheqian (plantain, 車前) 2 qian, Fuling 2 qian, Xinhui pi 1 qian, Jiao Guya 3 qian, Jing Guishen 2 qian, Suzi 3 qian, Zexie 1.5 qian, Banxia 1.5 qian, Dongguazi 3 qian.

The blood condition recurs, the right pulse wiry and rapid; at this ascending season, one should use the Xie Bai method (瀉白法).

Sangbaipi, Gualoupi, Maidong, Niuxi, stir-fried Miren, Digupi, Pipaye, Zhimu, Qiancao.

Hemoptysis recurs, and recently there is seminal emission; fortunately the pulse is not rapid and there is no wheezing — one can see that the yin aspect is not greatly depleted; it is injury to the yang collaterals. First regulate, then supplement.

Bei Shashen, Chuan Baihe, Qiancao, Ejiao, Huafen, Da Maidong, Bai Lianxu (white lotus stamen, 白蓮鬚), Danshen, Fushen.

Excessive loss of blood, qi obstructed and the yin collaterals full. Use the method of treating by promoting movement (以通為補).

Chuan Shihu, Guishen, stir-fried Suzi, Fa Banxia, Huai Niuxi, Jiao Guya, Fuling, Baishao, stir-fried Cheqian, Xinhui pi, Dongguazi.

Qi injured and blood overflowing, fire moving with cough and choking, the liver losing its nourishment, wood fire punishing metal — one should use a method of clearing the upper and absorbing the lower.

Yuan Shengdi, Jubai, Suzi, Huai Niuxi, Shijueming, Maidong rou, Danpi, Qiancao, Chuan Xuduan, Oujie.

Hemoptysis with sore throat, aversion to cold and wheezing with rebellion — middle deficiency with depletion of lung fluid. Treat by supplementing qi and protecting the lung.

Zhi Mianqi, Bei Shashen, Shanyao, Ejiao, Jubai, Shudi tan (charred prepared Rehmannia, 熟地炭), Da Maidong, Niuxi, Miren, Sangye.

After violent loss of blood, the collaterals are injured and the qi is timid, the pulse fine and without strength. Although there is cough and choking, it is not yin fire rushing upward, but insufficiency of qi causing it. Regulate with the Guipi method (歸脾法).

Zhi Mianqi 2 qian, Maidong 2 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Baishao 1 qian, Hafen stir-fried Ejiao 3 qian, Bei Shashen 2 qian, Yuanzhi 1 qian, soaked, Fushen 2 qian, Muli 4 qian, calcined, Jianlian rou 7 grains.

Vomiting and diarrhea with accumulated blood — qi deficiency with injury to the yin collaterals. I fear that after the turn of spring, the abdominal distension will not easily leave the body.

Jiao Zhu 2 qian, stir-fried Guishen 1.5 qian, Chuan Lianzi 1 qian, Baishao 1.5 qian, Chiling 3 qian, Muxiang 4 fen, roasted, stir-fried Qingpi (green tangerine peel, 炒青皮) 1 qian, Yanhusuo (Corydalis, 延胡索) 1 qian, Zexie 1.5 qian, Guya 3 qian.

The yang collaterals are injured, the blood condition occurring frequently; although there is no cough and choking, the six pulses are very wiry and rapid — this is not a favorable condition. The Beginning of Spring (立春) is near; regulate the treatment in advance.

Yuan Shengdi, Maidong, Taoren, Huaruishi (amphibole, 花蕊石), Zi Danshen, Oujie, Danpi, Niuxi, Qiancao, winter mulberry leaf, Cao Yujin.

Vomiting and diarrhea with accumulated blood, the yang and yin collaterals both injured, qi stagnant and the spleen trapped, unable to transport fluids and engender the new, the true qi of the lower burner not full, the clear and turbid hard in ascending and descending, without power to transport grain, abdominal distension with urination and defecation, the six pulses soft and weak without strength. It is proper to warm and supplement, assisted by a method of settling the spirit; then observe the news, and attach a formula for your consideration.

Earth-stir-fried Zhi Yuzhu 2 qian, Zhi Baishao (honey-fried white peony, 炙白芍) 2 qian, stir-fried Zaoren 3 qian, Tusizi 2 qian, Juye 3 leaves, earth-stir-fried Guishen 1.5 qian, Yun Fushen 2 qian, Chuan Yujin 1 qian, cut, added later, Zexie 1.5 qian, Jiao Guya 4 qian.

Re-consultation on the evening of the nineteenth: the left pulse is wiry and moving, with a little vexation and restlessness. This is liver yin deficiency and the spleen not transporting upward to supply. Again I propose a method of awakening the spleen and transforming qi, with the softening-liver method used in addition.

Earth-stir-fried Zhi Yuzhu 1 qian, Guishen 1.5 qian, wine-stir-fried, Zaoren 3 qian, Chuan Yujin 1 qian, Zexie 1.5 qian, Jiao Guya 4 fen, Hafen stir-fried Ejiao 2 qian, Baishao 2 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Zhi Shengma (honey-fried Cimicifuga, 炙升麻) 4 qian, Juye 3 leaves.

On the twentieth, the pulse of both hands is said to be smooth and harmonious, only that on heavy pressure there is little strength — one can see that the qi mechanism of the middle burner is somewhat relaxed, the true fire of the Mingmen (命門) is unable to restrain water, and the spleen yang is unable to move and transport, so that the lower body is edematous, heavy and sluggish, and food and drink can be taken in but are hard to transform. Still I propose a method of harmonizing the liver and stomach, assisted by supporting the primordial yang.

Stir-fried yellow Xi Dang 3 qian, Fushen 3 qian, Baji (Morinda, 巴戟) 1.5 qian, salt-water stir-fried, Chuan Yujin 1 qian, cut, added later, Zexie 1.5 qian, Jiao Guya 4 qian, earth-stir-fried Yuzhu 2 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Rougui 3 fen, peeled and ground, Zhi Shengma 4 fen, Juye 3 leaves.

Consultation on the twenty-third: abdominal distension and insomnia, the pulse instead wiry and rapid — without doubt wood is vigorous and earth is declining, caused by internal depletion of liver yin. Considering the symptoms with the pulse, I do not dare to supplement hastily; this formula is for temporary use.

Rice-water stir-fried Zhi Yuzhu, Guishen, Fuling, Chuan Yujin, Yuanmi stir-fried Maidong, Chidou (red bean, 赤豆) 30 grains, ginger-juice-processed Banxia, Baishao, Huoxiang (patchouli, 藿香), Huai Niuxi, ground and taken with water Rougui.

Consultation on the twenty-fifth: the middle cannot overcome damp, damp transforms into heat, and its qi cannot move freely and quickly, so that there is little power to rot grain, and urination and defecation are not free; the pulse is moving and still — take supporting the root as the main, and soothing and regulating as the auxiliary. My humble formula awaits your consideration.

Earth-stir-fried Zhi Yuzhu, Guishen, Dafu rong (areca peel, 大腹絨), Fushen, Yizhi (Alpinia, 益智), roasted Muxiang, Baishao, Pao Paojiang (roasted ginger, 泡炮姜), Cheqian, Rougui.

Deep thought and depression, internal stagnation with accumulated blood; after violent vomiting, the liver loses its nourishment, the qi mechanism is dull and sluggish, insulting the earth and making distension; examining the pulse, the right is wiry and the left is soft — one can see that the lower burner has no fire and the fluids do not supply upward. One should use the Jinkui method (金匱法).

Stir-fried Xi Dang, stir-fried Shudi, Chuan Fu (aconite, 川附), Niuxi, Danpi, Jiao Yuzhu, Kuai Fuling (lump Poria, 塊茯苓), Rougui, Zexie, Chidou.

After violent loss of blood, the vessels and collaterals are empty and deficient, and their qi has nothing to rely on; wheezing and rebellion increase day by day, the pulse rapid and without strength, the spleen and stomach not very strong and healthy — this is a condition of great deficiency. One should use a method of sweet and warm absorbing and supplementing.

Xi Dangshen, stir-fried Shudi, Fushen, Zi Shijing (fluorite, 紫石英), Niuxi, Zhi Yuzhu, stir-fried Qizi, Zaoren, Chuan Fuzi, Hutao.

Re-consultation: with the previously proposed warming and supplementing, the condition of the illness and the pulse have not shown advance or retreat, but the primordial qi has long been deficient, and only warming and supplementing is appropriate; there is no other strategy than this.

Xi Dang, Shudi, Maidong, Qizi, Fuzi, Yuzhu, Wuwei, Fushen, Cishi (magnetite, 磁石), Kanqi (placenta, 坎氣).

Formula for taking ginseng:

Renshen (ginseng, 人參), Yuzhu, Maidong, Wuwei, Fushen, Qizi, Zhi Cao.

Another follow-up formula: same as before, removing Kanqi, adding Hutao rou.

Violent vomiting of accumulated blood, hypochondriac masses insulting the middle — this is injury to the liver and spleen collaterals; I only fear abdominal fullness.

Chuan Shihu, Fuling, Biejia (turtle shell, 鱉甲), Yujin, Jiao Guya, stir-fried Suzi, Baishao, Xinhui, Houpo (Magnolia bark, 厚朴), Oujie.

The liver and stomach are not harmonious, and there was loss of blood — clearly the nutritive and defensive (營衛) are injured; one should only clear and regulate.

Sheng Baishao, Chuan Yujin, Fuling, Gougou, Jiangpi (ginger peel, 姜皮), stir-fried Suzi, Shijueming, Xinhui, Zexie.

Internally harboring summer evil, cough with phlegm and blood, the six pulses surging and large and not soft — the yin-supplementing agents should not be taken early.

Digupi, sheng Miren, Danpi, Juhong, Dongguazi, Sangbaipi, sheng Hake, Zhimu, Gancao, Maochai gen (imperata root, 茅柴根).
translator_notes: 鬥 (dou) is a traditional volume measure; kept as 'dou'.
骨蒸 (gu zheng) rendered as 'bone-steaming', a classical consumptive fever term.
金匱法 (Jinkui fa) refers to the method of the Jinkui Yaolue; kept as 'Jinkui method'.
